articles.title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump export ban threat
articles.summary: The coordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

articles.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
articles.summary: About 735 schools have faced disruption as violent protests over standards and lack of teachers continue.

articles.title: US murderer Christa Pike unconscious and on ventilator after failed execution, lawyers say
articles.summary: As of Thursday night, Pike remained critically ill and is being treated at a hospital in Nashville, Tennessee.
